A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. The window charges 70 separate visits, each one billed £33 at the door before it opens, and the jade is that the fee never comes back. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. saffron is written on the receipt. falcon stays on the record.
